name: Hannah Hamilton
source:
The other of the seventh holy knight corps first members. She is the head of the Ducis fan club, and is good at cooking. Her weapon is a hammer, and also knows a variety of healing, status-enhancing and attack magic.
[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Castle_Fantasia_2:_Seima_Taisen]Wikipedia[/url]]
